papers.title_en: CCDF: A Benchmark Dataset for Deepfake Detection in Real-World Surveillance Footage
papers.authors: Baptiste Chopin, Thomas Swearingen, Arun Ross, Antitza Dantcheva, Christian Rathgeb
papers.evidence: 面向监控视频的深度伪造检测基准数据集
papers.tldr: 商业AI视频工具可低成本伪造监控画面，可能误导犯罪报道与选举，而现有深伪数据集偏重普通网络内容、依赖旧生成器。本文提出CCDF基准，含1840段视频（460真实、1380生成），覆盖16类犯罪与事故，生成自Grok Imagine、VEO 3.1与Sora 2，并发布原始、清洗及后处理攻击三个版本。用十个最新检测器评测，它们难以可靠区分真假，尽管在旧数据集上表现优异。该数据集凸显现有基准与现实威胁评估之间的差距。
papers.abstract_en: Due to rapid advances in Generative AI, commercial video generation tools can be used to produce fabricated surveillance footage that can fool both human viewers and automated synthetic video detectors. Since these tools are so widely accessible, a malicious user can create a harmful video clip at minimal cost. The production and dissemination of such videos in high-stakes settings, such as crime reporting and elections, can misdirect emergency response efforts or distort political discourse. Existing deepfake video datasets, used by the research community to develop deepfake detection algorithms, exhibit two limitations: (1) they emphasize benign web content rather than footage of possibly malicious activity, and (2) they rely on older or open-source generators that do not represent recent advances in generative systems. We assemble CCtv DeepFakes (CCDF), a video deepfake dataset, to address both gaps. CCDF contains 1840 videos (460 real and 1380 generated) spanning 16 crime and accident categories, with generated content produced using three leading commercial systems: Grok Imagine, Google VEO 3.1, and OpenAI Sora 2. CCDF is a highly realistic, small-scale, manually annotated dataset targeting evaluation of detection models. We release three versions of the dataset: the raw generated data, a cleaned version in which video metadata are standardized between real and synthetic samples to prevent detectors from exploiting trivial cues, and an altered version simulating low-effort post-processing attacks. We evaluate CCDF with ten recent state-of-the-art detectors covering different detection approaches. Our results suggest that these approaches do not reliably distinguish CCDF's generated videos from real ones, despite their strong reported performance on existing datasets. These results further confirm that existing datasets are not well-suited to evaluating certain threats.

papers.title_en: MSU Team at the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026: Grounded Artifact Evidence for Deepfake Detection
papers.authors: Artem Filippov, Aleksandr Gushchin, Kirill Koltsov, Dmitriy Vatolin, Anastasia Antsiferova
papers.evidence: 深度伪造检测，多骨干检测器进行真假判别
papers.tldr: 生成图像模型使伪造图像高度逼真，检测器不仅要准确，还需提供可见取证证据，这是可解释深度伪造检测的核心挑战。本文提出模块化检测与解释方案：多骨干 DINOv3 结合 Mesorch 定位特征判断真假，并用 Grounding-DINO 伪掩码与 patch 级对比学习构建伪影证据图。语言端用类条件 Qwen3-VL 生成复杂解释，再经 GRPO 优化简化模型。在 XPlainVerse 全测试集上，检测准确率 0.9349，解释分数 0.5571，最终得分 0.7456，验证了方法的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative image models have made many manipulated images highly realistic, raising the need for detectors that are not only accurate but also able to provide visual evidence for their decisions. In this paper, we present our solution to the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge [2] on the XPlainVerse dataset [1], where systems are required to predict whether an image is real or fake and generate both complex and simple explanations grounded in visible forensic cues. Our method follows a modular detection-and-explanation design. For the real/fake decision, we build a multi-backbone detector that combines several DINOv3 models with Mesorch manipulation-localization features, bringing together pretrained visual representations, DCT-aware cues, and multi-scale forensic information. To inject explanation evidence into the detector, we use a Grounding-DINO-based pseudo-mask generation pipeline that converts local artifact descriptions from training explanations into weak patch- level supervision for an Artifact Evidence Map. We further introduce a local patch-level contrastive objective that separates artifact and authenticity evidence in the detector feature space without requiring paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks. For language output, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models to generate complex explanations for fake and real predictions, followed by a GRPO-optimized text simplification model. The proposed methods were trained and evaluated on the challenge subset of XPlainVerse. On the full test split, our submission achieves 0.9349 detection accuracy, 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.

papers.title_en: Relative Patch Response Learning for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.authors: Tianyu Wang, Ouxiang Li, Yanbin Hao, Zhenhua Tang, Shuo Wang
papers.evidence: 可泛化的AI生成图像检测，泛化至未见生成器
papers.tldr: 生成模型可合成高逼真图像，检测器需泛化到未见生成器并抵抗野外扰动。现有混合视图方法用生成块替换真实块，但自注意力使真假块交互，逐块源标签不再可靠。为此提出相对块响应学习PRL：比较同一块在两个混合视图间的得分变化，并用相对响应、参考一致与面积排序三目标进行监督。在八个标准与三个野外基准上，平均平衡准确率分别超越最优方法4.3%和5.9%。
papers.abstract_en: Generative models can now synthesize highly realistic images, simultaneously increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery. Therefore, detecting AI-generated images becomes more essential, and a reliable detector must generalize to unseen generators and stay robust to unseen perturbations in the wild. Existing detectors are typically trained on either independently collected real and generated images or aligned real-generated pairs designed to mitigate content bias. Building on aligned pairs, recent methods form a mixed view by replacing some patches of the real image with their generated counterparts. However, we find that self-attention lets real and generated patches interact, so the feature of each patch no longer reflects its own source alone. This contextual shift makes a per-patch source label an imprecise target. To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL). Instead of labeling each patch, PRL compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between the views. (i) To give precise supervision under the contextual shift, a relative response objective measures the responses of source-changed patches against those of source-unchanged patches, which respond to the shift alone. (ii) To provide a reliable reference for the shift, a reference coherence objective keeps each group of source-unchanged patches moving as a whole. (iii) Since the two views contain different amounts of generated content, an area ranking objective asks the view with the larger generated area to have a higher mean patch score. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of PRL, which surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy across eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.

papers.title_en: Not All Challenges Are Equal: Evaluating Interactive Liveness Detection Against Real-Time Face Swaps
papers.authors: Anton Firc, David Drtil, Martin Perešíni, Milan Šalko, Vojtěch Staněk, Kamil Malinka
papers.evidence: 针对实时换脸的交互式活体检测评估
papers.tldr: 远程身份验证默认摄像头画面中为真人，但公开实时换脸工具可在画面到达验证方前替换人脸，被动深伪检测器跨生成器泛化差，交互挑战的手势选择也缺乏证据。本文用108场真实会话、6名受试者、24个被冒充身份及DeepFaceLive与FaceFusion两款换脸工具，经虚拟摄像头注入，评估随机手势挑战。结果显示静态校准段AUC为0.878，主动手势窗口均值达0.988，姿态与组合手势点估计最高，表情无明显提升，遮挡掩码下针对FaceFusion的手部遮挡低于静态基线；满足校验器的端到端耗时也具区分力，AUC为0.732。
papers.abstract_en: Remote identity verification assumes that a camera stream shows a live person, yet public real-time face-swap tools can replace that person before the stream reaches the verifier. Passive deepfake detectors generalize poorly to new generators, while interactive challenges are often selected without evidence of which gestures expose current attacks. We evaluate randomized gesture challenges in 108 live sessions with six subjects, 24 impersonated identities, and two face-swap tools, DeepFaceLive and FaceFusion, injected through a virtual camera. The static calibration segment reaches a session-level AUC of 0.878 with a frozen UCF spatial detector, while the mean across the active-gesture windows reaches 0.988. Pose and combined gestures have the highest point estimates, whereas expressions show no clear improvement. Hand occlusion against FaceFusion, configured with an occlusion mask, scores below the static baseline. The end-to-end time required to satisfy the validator also distinguishes attacks from genuine sessions, achieving a session-level AUC of 0.732, although this signal includes synthesis and transport delays. These results show that challenge sets should be tested against current attack configurations and that response time can provide an additional, deployment-specific signal.

papers.title_en: EviStress: Evidence Stress Learning for Generalizable Face Forgery Detection with Textual Explanations
papers.authors: Jiuyao Jing, Xuanyu Yi, Yu Zheng, Chunlei Peng
papers.evidence: 面向未知篡改的人脸伪造检测
papers.tldr: 网络上面部伪造内容快速传播，且生成管线不断演化、传播中又经多样处理，导致跨数据集与跨方法的可靠性评估困难。作者观察到标准LoRA适配的CLIP检测器在patch级决策依赖上分布不均，少数视觉patch承载了过多类别相关性。为此提出两阶段框架EviStress：先用证据靶向patch扰动（ETPP）按全局、关系与语义线索施加正相关扰动概率，并用判别变异保持（DVP）约束干净与扰动表征的残差；再通过内在证据指令微调（IEIT）将适配后的CLIP编码器接入LLaVA作视觉塔，实现免外部检测器的真伪预测与文本解释。实验显示跨数据集、跨方法泛化与腐蚀鲁棒性均有提升。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid spread of face forgeries on the Web challenges the credibility of visual content. In practical Web environments, manipulated media originate from evolving generation pipelines and undergo diverse processing during dissemination, making reliable authenticity assessment under unseen manipulations and visual changes a critical challenge. We observe that a standard LoRA-adapted CLIP detector exhibits uneven patch-level decision dependence, concen trating a disproportionate share of class-specific relevance on a small fraction of visual patches. To improve robustness to variations in such highly dependent evidence, we propose EviStress, a two-stage framework for generalizable face forgery detection with textual explanations. In the first stage, Evidence-Targeted Patch Perturbation (ETPP) estimates patch dependence from global, relational, and semantic cues and assigns positively correlated perturbation probabilities, explicitly stress-testing highly dependent visual evidence during training. We further introduce Discriminative Variation Preservation (DVP), which constrains the residual between clean and perturbed representations to retain authenticity discriminative information. In the second stage, Intrinsic Evidence Instruction Tuning (IEIT) transfers the adapted CLIP encoder into LLaVA as its vision tower and performs parameter-efficient multimodal instruction tuning, enabling authenticity prediction and textual explanation directly from the learned forgery-sensitive representation without an external detector. Experiments demonstrate improved cross-dataset and cross-method generalization and corruption robustness, with the multimodal model providing authenticity predictions and human-readable explanations.

papers.title_en: COMPASS: Contextual Moment Prior Alignment for Generalizable AIGI Detection
papers.authors: Zhan Yang, Tiancheng Shen, Weijie Lyu, Shuo Chen, Bernard Ghanem, Yibo Yang, Ming-Hsuan Yang
papers.evidence: 可泛化的AI生成图像与深度伪造检测
papers.tldr: 通用 AI 生成图像与深度伪造检测存在不对称现象：适配有限训练分布会损害视觉基础模型的迁移表征。COMPASS 提出数据感知子空间适配，用少量无标注语义代理集估计目标激活统计，并将激活协方差融入预训练权重分解。它保留目标相关表征作为稳定语义参考，让残差适配器学习伪造相关变化，且代理校准无需梯度优化。在跨数据集、跨方法、联合跨数据集-方法及开放世界跨生成器评测中达到 SOTA，兼顾深度伪造与 AIGI 检测。
papers.abstract_en: Generalizable AI-generated image (AIGI) and deepfake detection remain challenging due to the asymmetry phenomenon, where adaptation to limited training distributions can degrade the transferable representations of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). Recent subspace adaptation methods mitigate this issue by freezing high-magnitude principal components while adapting the residual subspace. However, such magnitude-based decomposition is data-agnostic and does not explicitly account for target-relevant semantics, potentially leading to semantic misalignment. We propose COMPASS (COntextual Moment Prior Alignment for Subspace Separation), a data-aware subspace adaptation framework that uses a small unlabeled Semantic Proxy Set to estimate target activation statistics. COMPASS incorporates activation covariance into the decomposition of pre-trained weights, preserving target-relevant representations as a stable semantic reference while the residual adapter learns forgery-related variations. The proxy calibration requires no gradient-based optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong generalization across cross-dataset, cross-method, joint cross-dataset-method, and open-world cross-generator evaluations, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both Deepfake and AIGI detection benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Visual Provenance: Detection and Watermarking Across Direct Visual Generation and LLM-Driven Code Rendering
papers.authors: Zheng Gao, Xiaoyu Li, Zhicheng Bao, Yang Song, Jiaojiao Jiang
papers.evidence: AI生成图像与视频的检测与水印
papers.tldr: AI既可直出图像视频，也可由LLM写代码或图形描述再渲染，两路视觉痕迹相似，但表征、干预点与溯源证据不同。本文提出以生产为中心的框架，跨两条路线比较检测与水印，并用验证规范区分被动推断、消息恢复与认证溯源，按生产阶段组织水印。工作梳理图像视频、图表与SVG、可编程视频及智能体工作流的需求，结合Claude、OpenAI与渲染工具接口提出十个研究问题。其贡献是概念性研究议程，不做实验、不证新定理，为视觉溯源提供统一对照视角。
papers.abstract_en: AI systems create images and videos with image/video generation models or by writing code and graphics descriptions that are then rendered. These routes can produce similar visible artifacts but expose different representations, intervention points, and provenance evidence. We develop a production-centered framework that compares detection and watermarking across both routes. An explicit verification specification distinguishes passive inference, message recovery, and authenticated provenance. We organize image, video, source-code, and rendering-aware watermarks by production stage. We examine the different requirements of generated images and video, plots and SVG, programmable video, and agent-composed workflows. Documented Claude, OpenAI, and rendering-tool interfaces connect the framework to concrete systems. We pose ten scoped research questions on identifiability, observability, fair comparison across stages, recoverable payload, reconstruction, synchronization, composition, hybrid local contribution, and private production-event authentication. The result is a conceptual research agenda grounded in published methods, inspected interfaces, and elementary boundary examples. It reports no experiments and claims no new theorems; its appendix results are elementary calculations, and documentation and source inspection establish interfaces, not empirical robustness.

papers.title_en: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
papers.authors: Jiahua Li, Zixu John, Tom Zhong, Fuping Wu, Tianhao Xu, Jianqing Zheng, Yuanhan Mo, Fei Shen
papers.evidence: 利用预训练模型内部知识的图像伪造检测
papers.tldr: 生成图像日益逼真，可靠伪造检测对维护视觉信息信任至关重要，但现有方法多依赖任务监督适配视觉基础模型，未充分利用内部取证知识。作者提出Reserve-Guided Elicitation（RGE），用Forensic Lens分解各层与token组激活，筛选真假图响应差异，定位取证储备位点与方向。随后构建固定储备子空间，仅在位点插入Forensic Reserve Adapters，训练系数图生成受约束的输入相关残差。仅用500张标注图、可训练参数不足骨干0.2%，在三个基准上无需目标适配即达竞争性能，并跨八种预训练编码器稳定提升冻结检测器。
papers.abstract_en: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

papers.title_en: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.authors: Zhiheng Peng, Wenwei Jin, Yangshi Ge, Siyu Xia, Jiawei Li, Xu Tang
papers.evidence: 面向新兴生成器的持续AI生成图像检测
papers.tldr: AI生成图像检测器通常依赖固定生成器域训练，新模型出现后难以维持，且持续适应中重放历史图像成本高、更新共享参数会遗忘旧取证知识。EvoKnow将持续检测建模为取证知识演化，冻结基础域学到的共享取证基，增量添加孤立残差专家，并用解析增量路由器AIR以闭式解融合当前图像与累积充分统计量。每新增一个生成器仅用十张生成图，即在非基础GenImage上达96.70%平均准确率，Chameleon上94.48%；严格无重放协议下平均阶段准确率96.32%、平均遗忘4.32%。
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics. Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.

papers.authors: Zheng Gao, Xiaoyu Li, Zhicheng Bao, Jiaojiao Jiang

papers.title_en: Camera-Noise Residuals for Face-Swap Detection: Redundant, Not Complementary, and Why
papers.authors: Danil Davydov, Bader Rasheed, Dmitriy Vatolin
papers.evidence: 基于相机噪声残差的换脸深度伪造检测
papers.tldr: 本文检验相机噪声残差能否为换脸检测提供与RGB外观主干互补的信息。作者在FaceForensics++上比较RGB Xception、Noiseprint++残差及后期融合三模型，并用七级瓶颈诊断定位残差信号。结果显示融合未超过RGB，残差单支接近随机；残差判别性主要来自样本级均值、方差和能量，却被输入端InstanceNorm标准化抹除，五折AUC从0.747降至0.554。固定融合变体虽恢复该统计信号，仍在各数据集上不敌RGB，表明该分布下噪声残差对RGB冗余而非互补。
papers.abstract_en: Fusing a learned camera-noise fingerprint with an RGB appearance backbone is an appealing route to generator-independent deepfake detection, because the noise residual is grounded in image-formation physics rather than in the texture statistics of a particular generator. We test, on FaceForensics++, whether a Noiseprint++ residual channel carries information \emph{complementary} to an RGB Xception backbone for face-swap detection. A three-model ablation (RGB-only, residual-only, late-fusion) shows that fusion does not improve over RGB alone and that the residual branch alone is near chance. A seven-level bottleneck diagnostic localizes the cause: the noise maps do carry a discriminative signal, but it is statistical---carried by the per-sample first and second moments (mean, variance, energy) of the residual---and the per-sample \texttt{InstanceNorm} layer placed at the noise-branch input, following the TruFor template, standardizes exactly those moments away (five-fold cross-validated AUC drops from $0.747$ to $0.554$). A context-crop control rules out cropping geometry, and two fixed-fusion variants that remove the bottleneck recover the statistical signal yet still fail to beat RGB on every dataset. We conclude that, on this manipulation distribution, the noise residual is redundant with RGB rather than complementary, and we give concrete guidance for practitioners adopting noise-residual fusion for face-swap detection.

papers.title_en: DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Wenhao Li, Xianjing Meng, Qiangchang Wang, Zhongyi Han, Yilong Yin, Liqiang Nie
papers.evidence: 面向少样本的视觉语言对齐学习
papers.tldr: 小样本学习常借助文本语义弥补视觉样本不足，但图文高一致性可能混入背景等偶然上下文，导致支持原型被污染。DVLA-RL++在DVLA-RL基础上引入互补语义净化CSP与反事实强化学习门控CRG：CSP区分内在与干扰描述并按歧义度稀疏分配证据，CRG学习逐层融合强度。在标准、细粒度与跨域等多类基准上取得最优精度，较DVLA-RL平均提升1.4%。理论分析还建立原型稳定性与可靠无偏同策略梯度估计条件。
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.

papers.title_en: Not Every Cue Is Evidence: Cue Supportability for Forensic Distillation in Face Forgery Detection
papers.authors: Binjia Zhou, Dawei Luo, Shuai Chen, Feng Xu, Haoyuan Li, Jia wen Seow, Jiachi Wang, Jie Lei, Zunlei Feng, Yijun Bei
papers.evidence: 可解释人脸伪造检测与取证证据支撑性
papers.tldr: 可解释人脸伪造检测不仅要求判断正确，还需给出输入图像可支持的取证证据。然而训练线索多源自伪造生成流程，图像质量有限，学生模型难以感知细粒度痕迹，易出现答案正确但证据错误（CAWE）的失败。本文提出双支持性审计，在蒸馏前过滤特权线索：候选线索需能从剩余特权上下文预测，且与当前图像高归因视觉区域存在因果联系。仅满足双重条件的线索获得显著蒸馏权重，从而阻止无依据细节泄漏。在八个基准上，方法保持或提升检测精度，并显著提高解释忠实度。
papers.abstract_en: Explainable face forgery detection requires not only correct judgments but also forensic evidence supported by the input image. However, training cues are typically derived from the forgery generation pipeline. Since images available to the model are of limited quality and resolution, it is difficult to observe the fine-grained traces these cues refer to. Training methods that further supply such cues as privileged supervision exacerbate the problem, as the student is taught to articulate evidence it cannot perceive. The student consequently resorts to templated or over-generalized expressions, giving rise to the correct-answer, wrong-evidence (CAWE) failure. We propose a dual supportability audit that filters privileged cues before distillation. Each candidate cue must be predictable from the remaining privileged context and causally tied to high-attribution visual regions in the current image. Only cues satisfying both conditions receive substantial distillation weight, preventing unsupported details from leaking into the student. Experiments across eight benchmarks show that our method maintains or improves detection accuracy while significantly raising explanation faithfulness compared to existing paradigms.

papers.title_en: Can We Model the Artifacts Explicitly? Disentangle Artifacts via Pairwise Edit Relations for Image Manipulation Localization
papers.authors: Xuekang Zhu, Kaiwen Feng, Ruifeng Wang, Xiwen Wang, Xiaochen Ma, Bo Du, Changjiang Jiang, Chenfan Qu, Songyu Ye, Xia Du, Wentao Feng, Jian Liu, Ji-Zhe Zhou
papers.evidence: 图像篡改定位与显式伪影解耦
papers.tldr: 图像篡改定位（IML）常被当作全监督掩码预测，但篡改伪影本质是隐变量，现有模型隐式建模导致定位不足。本文据此把IML重写为隐变量积分，提出两阶段PAL与SL范式：先借成对编辑关系估计P(z|x)，再估计P(y|z)，从而显式解耦伪影。作者构建源锚定的EditGroup-45K数据集支持成对学习。实验显示PAL能跨多种IML架构一致提升，并验证其确实显式捕获伪影。
papers.abstract_en: Image Manipulation Localization (IML) is commonly formulated as a fully supervised learning task that estimates the optimal manipulation mask $y$ for a given image $x$. In this work, we first reveal the latent nature of artifacts and thus reinterpret IML as a latent-variable problem, $P(y|x)=\int P(y|z)\,P(z|x)\,dz$, where $z$ denotes the artifacts. Following this interpretation, we pinpoint the cause for the current IML models' insufficiency as their implicit artifacts modeling strategy, highlighting the necessity of modeling $z$ in an explicit manner. Without direct labels, feature disentanglement is the most appropriate solution for this explicit modeling. Accordingly, we propose a two-stage learning paradigm with the Pairwise Artifacts Learning (PAL) and Standard Localization (SL) phases to estimate $P(z|x)$ and $P(y|z)$ via edit relations. To support our edit-relation-based learning, we further curate EditGroup-45K, a source-anchored dataset organized into edit groups for pair construction. Extensive experiments show that our PAL paradigm yields consistent improvements across diverse IML architectures, and empirical analyses further verify that PAL does capture artifacts explicitly through feature disentanglement. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/venus-guangjian/PAL

papers.title_en: FedSSMCoOp: SSM Encoders for light-weight Federated Prompt Learning for Few-shot Classification
papers.authors: Ankita Das, Ambarish Parthasarathy, Sumohana S. Channappayya, C. Krishna Mohan
papers.evidence: 少样本图像分类与跨模态特征对齐
papers.tldr: 针对联邦生物医学少样本分类中数据不能共享、标注稀缺且机构异质性强的问题，现有VLM多依赖余弦相似度对齐，忽略token级结构与跨模态交互。FedSSMCoOp引入基于SSM的Vision Mamba与Cross Mamba模块，在联邦设置下仅优化软提示与通信提示，实现隐私保护的多模态轻量学习。方法无需外部LLM做特征对齐，在多个生物医学数据集上稳定优于基线，平均轻量1.96倍。为联邦少样本图像分类提供了一种高效且实用的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance across a wide range of downstream vision tasks, thanks to the complementary information contained in the respective domains. Despite the performance gains, most of these approaches rely on aligning these domains using the cosine similarity metric, which fails to capture token-level structure and cross-modal interactions prior to the classification stage. This is especially critical in biomedical applications under federated constraints, where data sharing is restricted, labeled data is scarce at each site, and it differs widely across institutions, leading to substantial statistical heterogeneity. To overcome this issue, we propose FedSSMCoOp, a federated few-shot image classification framework that enables multimodal learning while preserving data privacy. With the help of the SSM-based Vision Mamba and Cross Mamba blocks, and by optimizing only the soft-prompt and communication-prompt updates in the federated setting, the framework prioritizes both computation and performance. Importantly, this eliminates the need to use an external Large Language Model (LLM) for feature alignment. The framework is further trained and evaluated on various biomedical image datasets, and its performance is assessed. The proposed framework delivers stable performance relative to the baselines and is, on average, 1.96 times lighter. The corresponding script will be made available soon.

papers.title_en: CARE: Constrained Attention Refinement for Fine-Grained Visual Classification via Teacher-Student Distillation
papers.authors: Ruibo Wen, Hang Shao, Yiming Lei
papers.evidence: 基于注意力细化与蒸馏的细粒度视觉分类
papers.tldr: 细粒度视觉分类既要识别细微局部特征，又要给出可解释证据，但类特定注意力路径结构受限，判别力不足且未充分利用预训练骨干中间表示。为此提出CARE，用教师-学生蒸馏：学生保留类特定注意力预测与解释，训练期辅助查询教师读取DINOv2选定中间层，融合多级表示并传递logit标准化类别判别知识，同时以多样性和稀疏正则约束注意力头。在CUB等四个数据集上，冻结骨干可解释设定下CUB Top-1达78.5%，插入/删除分析显示高排名注意力区域保留类别相关证据。该框架兼顾可解释性与细粒度分类精度。
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained visual classification requires models to recognize subtle local traits while exposing the visual evidence behind their predictions. Class-specific attention pathways provide a natural basis for interpretable recognition, but their constrained prediction structure limits discriminative capacity and underuses intermediate representations from strong pretrained backbones. To address this problem, we propose CARE, a constrained attention refinement framework for interpretable fine-grained recognition via teacher-student distillation. CARE keeps the final prediction and explanation within a class-specific attention student, while introducing a training-only auxiliary query teacher that reads selected intermediate DINOv2 layers with learnable queries. The teacher fuses multi-level representations and transfers logit-standardized class-discriminative knowledge to the student. To further refine the explanation pathway, we design diversity and sparsity terms to regularize student attention heads, reducing redundancy and encouraging compact trait localization. Experiments on CUB, Oxford-IIIT Pet, Stanford Dogs, and Stanford Cars show that CARE achieves strong classification performance under an interpretable frozen-backbone setting, reaching 78.5% Top-1 accuracy on CUB. Faithfulness analysis with insertion and deletion metrics further indicates that the top-ranked attention regions retain class-relevant evidence for explanation.

papers.title_en: WorldFact-Bench: Beyond Image-Internal Plausibility to Image-World Consistency
papers.authors: Zhuohong Chen, Zhengxian Wu, Yunyao Yu, Hangrui Xu, Zijian Yu, Hao Tan, Zhifang Liu, Peng Jiao, Jun Lan, Haoqian Wang
papers.evidence: 用于图像取证的真假图像对
papers.tldr: 图像生成愈发逼真，但视觉合理的图像仍可能违背真实世界事实。作者提出WorldFact-Bench，从单张图像评估图像-世界一致性，含1274对源对齐真假样本，覆盖四种验证机制与十个语义域，且无需预设声明。同时提出PERSIST-Agent，用持久状态串联候选事实、视觉观察、证据与验证状态，引导迭代检查与检索，并通过验证反馈自优化提示与执行规则。在8B骨干上，其配对准确率超越直接判断与检索增强基线。
papers.abstract_en: Advances in image generation have made visual authenticity increasingly difficult to assess. Although image forensics now examines both generation artifacts and higher-level visual inconsistencies, a plausible image can still contradict real-world facts or rules. We introduce WorldFact-Bench to evaluate image-world consistency from a single image, without a predefined claim or verification target. The benchmark contains 1,274 source-aligned real-fake pairs across four verification regimes and ten semantic domains. Each pair introduces a specific, evidence-supported factual conflict while seeking to preserve non-target content and visual plausibility. Images are evaluated independently, and pair accuracy requires both members of a pair to be classified correctly. We further propose PERSIST-Agent, which organizes iterative verification around a persistent state linking candidate facts, visual observations, evidence, and verification statuses. This state guides subsequent inspection and retrieval while retaining unresolved candidates. With backbone weights fixed, harness self-optimization refines the agent's prompts and execution rules through validation feedback. Experiments reveal strong label biases in several detectors and uneven gains from retrieval. On the evaluated 8B backbones, PERSIST-Agent improves pair accuracy over both direct judgment and retrieval-augmented baselines, while ablations support the role of persistent verification state. These findings highlight the value of state-guided verification and the remaining gap between visual plausibility and factual correctness.
